scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof of generic identifiability is provided. Algebraic witness checks are finite only; no independent audit or publication-level validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only almost-everywhere uniqueness for complex degree at most d, d>=3, m=2d-1 full roots-of-unity sites, ordinary derivative and intensity; no universal or minimum-site claim, quantitative stability, or classification of all exceptional fibers.
title: Generic recovery of analytic polynomials from derivative intensities at \(2d-1\) roots of unity
